utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — did the book club pick the next read yet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not yet, but we’re deciding this week. I’ll let you know once we settle on one.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’d love to know what you all pick.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in for book club—just point me to the next one and I’ll skim it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—next up is "The Last Garden". I’ll send the meetup time and a quick summary.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, send it over and I’ll do my usual quick skim. I’ll be there if I can make the time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we actually doing the book club this week? I just want to make sure before I show up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to confirm the time and place first so nobody shows up wrong.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, let’s confirm it first. Just text me the time and place when you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club! I’m a bit forgetful, but I’m happy to help; what are we reading again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re reading "The Midnight Library" this month—I'll bring the extra copies I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, "The Midnight Library" — thanks for bringing the extra copies. I’ll try to remember to show up on time this time!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Noah—before I say yes, can you tell me which book club meeting you mean and what the plan is?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—sorry, I mean the book club meeting at my place next Thursday. We’d just chat about the book and maybe bring a snack.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that sounds doable. What time next Thursday, and is there a book choice I should finish first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we were just about to pick it. We’re leaning toward a mystery, but I can catch you up fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’m in the mood for a mystery. What are the options?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Gus — what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re reading "The Shadow of the Wind" this week — if you need a spare copy, I’ve got one you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus — I’d love to borrow it if you don’t mind. I’ll swing by and pick it up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets at the community center on Maple Street, but I should double-check the exact room.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds right — if you can check the room, I can make sure it fits around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the room and let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new read soon—should be a good one to chat about. I’ll let you know if I catch the title first!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh nice, if you hear it first, send it my way — I’d love to join and help spread the word to the others!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll keep my ears open and pass it along as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, are we still on for book club this week, and what chapter are we covering?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m still in for this week. I think we were covering the next chapter, but I should double-check the exact one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — can you double-check and let me know which chapter it is?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll let everyone know the book club plan and make sure it’s easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for the update and pass it along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll share the book club plan with everyone and keep it clear. If anything changes, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’m glad we’re getting the book club started. What kind of books would you like us to read first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d start with something gentle and easy to talk about—maybe a short novel or a collection of stories.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect—I’ll look for a short, gentle pick that gives everyone plenty to talk about.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking something really good this month—want me to find out what it is?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please do. I’d like to know the title so I can read it ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and let you know the title as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re picking it tonight, and I’ll repeat the plan once we decide.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’m here now — what are the options?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, hey Uli — I’m interested in the book club. What are you all reading next?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re starting with a mystery novel next week. If you want, I can bring you the title.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks — I’d like to take a look before next week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—I'll send the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just text me when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds lovely — what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got it right before I say—what’s the title again?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — it’s “The Midnight Library.”

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—book club. Did we decide on the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, but I can bring a few options to the next meeting and we can vote.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—thanks, Mara. I’ll try to remember to bring my list too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new read this week—sounds like a good one. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m planning to swing by and see what everyone picks. If you need, I can bring a few spare chairs too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks—extra chairs would really help. I’ll probably stop by for a bit and see what they choose.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Leo — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help pick the next book and send the invite out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can pick the next book and send out the invite. Any genre in mind, or should I choose one?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to join, but I should know the time and address first so I can plan my evening.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Of course — we’re meeting at 7:00 PM at my place on Maple Street. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that should work for me. Can you send the exact house number too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club sounds lovely — I’ll spread the word and invite everyone I know!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be wonderful, Quinn — thank you. I’ll make sure we have enough chairs and tea for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll start inviting folks right away and make sure they know about the chairs and tea. This is going to be such a nice gathering!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make book club work if we keep it after school pickup—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: After pickup sounds perfect—maybe around 4:30? I’m a bit forgetful, but I can jot it down this time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 works for me, and I’ll put it on my calendar too. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet when I come by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve been thinking we could keep the book club cozy and low-key this month—maybe pick something everyone can actually finish. What kind of book are you in the mood for, Nell?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely—honestly, I’m up for something easy to get through, maybe a short mystery or a feel-good novel. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m happy to go with the group.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: A short mystery sounds perfect—I’ll put together a couple of cozy options and we can pick one that feels fun for everyone.
